radar.do_en: Trim chasing; favour good entries over extended leaders.
radar.do_zh: 减少追高；择优入场而非追逐已延展的龙头。

cycle.trough_window_zh: 历史上约在 2026 年 8–10 月见底
cycle.stat_en: Midterm Apr–Oct drawdowns averaged −15% vs −10% otherwise (n=8, suggestive not significant, p≈0.09; the worst years on record are non-midterm).
cycle.stat_zh: 中期选举年 4–10 月最大回撤平均约 −15%（其余年份约 −10%；n=8，仅具提示性、未达显著，p≈0.09；史上最深回撤多发生在非中期年）。
cycle.slice_en: Edge is narrow: while the tape is still healthy (S&P above its 200-day), this window has flagged ≥5% pullbacks at ~1.25× the base rate — early warning, sized not triggered.
cycle.slice_zh: 优势有限：当大盘仍健康（标普高于 200 日线）时，该窗口的 ≥5% 回撤概率约为常态的 1.25 倍——用于提前预警与降低仓位，而非触发买卖。
cycle.caveat_en: Calendar context only — it modulates sizing/sensitivity, never originates an alert. The Dollar-Milkshake direction (firmer dollar in midterm H2) is actually reversed in history; trust the radar's measured dollar/rate/CNH legs, not the year.
cycle.caveat_zh: 仅为日历背景——只调节仓位/灵敏度，绝不独立触发警报。历史上「美元里程碑」方向（中期下半年美元更强）实际相反；请相信雷达已验证的美元/利率/离岸人民币因子，而非年份本身。

sector_bias.note_en: Midterm H2 tilt: defensives (XLV/XLP/XLU) have held while cyclicals (XLE/XLY) faded — but most of this is ordinary H2 seasonality (n=6), not a midterm effect.
sector_bias.note_zh: 中期下半年倾向：防御板块（XLV/XLP/XLU）相对抗跌、周期板块（XLE/XLY）走弱——但其中多为普通的下半年季节性（n=6），并非中期专属效应。

modulation.reason_en: Midterm risk-on window — early-tier sensitivity raised (~1.25× base) and gross trimmed; loud banner still requires the broad tape to break.
modulation.reason_zh: 中期选举「风险开」窗口——提高早期预警灵敏度（约 1.25 倍）并小幅降仓；响亮警报仍需大盘破位。

amp_flags_zh: 自满 — VIX 平静但脆弱

catalysts.detail_en: Net liquidity (WALCL − RRP − TGA) rising — TGA drawdown / reserves added.
catalysts.detail_zh: 净流动性（WALCL − RRP − TGA）上升 — TGA 回落／准备金注入。

recovery.headline_zh: 风险回落 — 流动性转向支持
recovery.sub_zh: 回撤概率 19% → 16%（3 日前见顶）。
recovery.do_en: The risk-off may be nearing its end. Begin scaling exposure back in tranches — keep stops, let price confirm the low. Don't chase the first bounce.
recovery.do_zh: 避险或已接近尾声。可分批逐步回补敞口 — 保留止损，待价格确认低点，切勿追逐首次反弹。
recovery.caveat_en: Illustrative context, not a buy trigger. It reads the radar's own intensity trajectory (leak-free) plus the display-only central-bank liquidity series; unlike the alert legs it is not forward-tested yet, and risk can re-accelerate. The de-risk → re-risk response is sizing, scaled in deliberately. BoJ enters only via the aggregate global central-bank tide (no isolated BoJ feed).
recovery.caveat_zh: 仅为示意性背景，并非买入信号。它读取雷达自身的强度轨迹（无未来函数）以及仅供展示的央行流动性序列；不同于警报腿，此读数尚未经前瞻检验，风险可能再度加速。降险→回补的应对是仓位管理、分批进行。日本央行仅通过全球央行总潮汐体现（无独立日本数据源）。

headline_en: Mixed / transition — the signals disagree. Trade smaller, favour quality, take profits faster; don't position aggressively.
headline_zh: 混合 / 转换 — 信号分歧。缩小仓位、偏好质量、更快获利了结；勿激进布局。

components.read_zh: 3/3 个美股指数多周期呈上升趋势。

components.read_zh: 联储流动性扩张；高收益信用走阔

components.read_zh: 下行风险低；回撤区间低
